listings_owner_shape_check.name: listings_owner_shape_check
listings_owner_shape_check.value:
("listings"."owner_type" = 'user' and "listings"."oxy_user_id" is not null and "listings"."store_id" is null)
       or ("listings"."owner_type" = 'store' and "listings"."store_id" is not null and "listings"."oxy_user_id" is null)

orders_seller_shape_check.name: orders_seller_shape_check
orders_seller_shape_check.value:
("orders"."seller_type" = 'user' and "orders"."seller_oxy_user_id" is not null and "orders"."store_id" is null)
       or ("orders"."seller_type" = 'store' and "orders"."store_id" is not null and "orders"."seller_oxy_user_id" is null)

vehicles_owner_shape_check.name: vehicles_owner_shape_check
vehicles_owner_shape_check.value:
("vehicles"."owner_type" = 'courier' and "vehicles"."courier_oxy_user_id" is not null and "vehicles"."company_id" is null)
       or ("vehicles"."owner_type" = 'company' and "vehicles"."company_id" is not null and "vehicles"."courier_oxy_user_id" is null)

generated.as: case when status = 'dismissed' then created_at end

jobs_fulfillment_shape_check.name: jobs_fulfillment_shape_check
jobs_fulfillment_shape_check.value:
("jobs"."fulfillment_type" = 'moovo_courier' and "jobs"."provider_ref" is null)
       or ("jobs"."fulfillment_type" = 'external_provider'
           and "jobs"."provider_ref" is not null
           and "jobs"."courier_oxy_user_id" is null
           and "jobs"."company_id" is null)

shipments_scheduling_shape_check.name: shipments_scheduling_shape_check
shipments_scheduling_shape_check.value:
("shipments"."scheduling_kind" = 'scheduled' and "shipments"."scheduled_for" is not null)
       or ("shipments"."scheduling_kind" = 'now' and "shipments"."scheduled_for" is null)
